comment: PHPJava bench under PHP CLI with three optimisation levels. Run via bench-cli.php (CLI, not FFM, because libphp8.4-embed on this Debian system does not load Zend extensions — see bench/README.md). All timings nanoseconds-per-iteration unless noted.

empty-method-100.note: 100 calls. JIT regresses by 8x — JIT compile cost not amortised.

iadd-1k.note: 5.4us / 5.3us / 4.78us per JVM bytecode op (1000-iter inner loop = ~8000 ops/call).

helloworld.note: Class-load + tiny main(). JIT regresses 3.4x — short workload.
